notes.title: "Spring & Autumn: Chronicles" — First Playtest Now Live
notes.content:
[p][b]Spring & Autumn: Chronicles[/b] – A narrative RPG with DBG, set in a world of chaos and shifting allegiances.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597004/8417996b71bae73f722907122ce2121e60f31893.png"][/img][/p][p]🔹 [b]Story & Exploration[/b]
Set during the turbulent Spring and Autumn period, players are free to explore rival states, borderlands, and hidden paths. Meet a wide range of characters, make pivotal decisions, and experience a richly branching narrative. [/p][p]Over [b]200,000 words of interactive script[/b] interweave main quests and side stories, offering [b]multiple endings and unique personal journeys[/b].[/p][p]🔹 [b]Deck-Building [/b]
The game features a card-based combat system. Build your deck through dialogue events, exploration, and training.[/p][p]Engage in diverse challenges—from combat and debate to cooking—each requiring its own strategy and synergy.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]First Online Playtest Now Open![/b]
We're now publicly testing the [i]Laiwu Moucheng[/i] chapter. Want to try it out early?
[b]Join our official QQ :[/b] [b]927944053[/b][/p]
